gpa_excludes: withdrawals, audits, incompletes, pass/fail outcomes, transfers, and missing grades

privacy_suppression.rule: Course, professor, professor-course, professor-year, and course-instructor grade aggregates with fewer than ten graded students are omitted from public artifacts.

offering_history.semantics: A missing course means not offered only for terms listed in complete_terms. Incomplete, failed, and absent term sources remain unknown and are excluded from denominators.
